title: Whale Songs Go Viral: One Hit Crossed the Pacific in Two Years

scenes.text: Whales have hit songs, and they spread across the Pacific like viral music.
Scientists tracked humpback songs across six neighboring populations over a decade.
A new song would start in one group, and soon every male in the area sang the same tune.
Within about two years, a song from Australia reached French Polynesia, moving east.
Only one song traveled west in the whole study.
No radio, no internet. Just a hit song, passed from whale to whale.

description:
Humpback whales pass songs from group to group, like hit records.
One new song crossed from Australia to French Polynesia in about two years.
What would your whale song sound like?
first_comment: Would you listen to a whale's top ten? Tell us.
